meta.title: Sat2Soil — From Satellite to Soil
meta.description: Field-scale decision support built on NASA Earth observation data: water, crop rotation, climate fit and digital twin scenarios.

common.devPreview: Development preview — no live NASA data is shown yet.

landing.title: From Satellite to Soil, From Data to Decisions.
landing.lead: Sat2Soil turns NASA Earth observation data into clear, explainable decisions for a single field: water, crop rotation and climate fit.

data.title: NASA data, clearly labelled
data.body: Climate series from NASA POWER for your field's location, with source, unit, period and grid resolution on every chart.

decide.title: Water and crop rotation
decide.body: Compare your current plan with an alternative rotation, with every assumption and uncertainty spelled out.

device.title: Field measurement concept
device.body: AgriSpray shows what a future portable device could add. Its readings are simulated today and always marked that way.

demo.title: Demo
demo.comingSoon: Field selection arrives in phase 3: open the sample field in the Konya Plain or draw your own.
